::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feb 24 [1894]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford: MS English Letters: e.174 ff 137
:::

Dear [Mr Bullock](people/person_221.qmd),	
I would have offered to write [Fletcher](people/person_1677.qmd)’s Life, but I have hunted all over the house twice over and cannot find the [book](other_books/otherbook_213.qmd) I once had, but no doubt you can get it from a library[^1]

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘The Revd  J.F.  Bullock/Radwinter Rectory/Saffron Walden. Postmark Feb 24/94.
[^2]: CMY wrote several in a series of 'Biographies of Eminent Anglicans', which were intended to form part of Bullock's *Daily Lections* project, but were never published.
